basic_profile.bio: I'm a gaming enthusiast who recently got into the world of Reddit. Originally from Melbourne, Australia, I enjoy exploring new games and sharing tips with fellow gamers. I have a particular fondness for RPGs and am currently diving deep into Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia. When I'm not gaming, I work as a graphic designer for a local agency. I'm in a committed relationship and enjoy spending my weekends discovering new music and watching classic rock documentaries. I'm typically online during the evenings and late nights, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in graphic design, having studied it at university and worked in the field for over three years. My gaming knowledge is largely self-taught, picking up tips and strategies from online forums and video guides. I love experimenting with different gaming strategies, especially in RPGs.
